slices.focus: A post-wedding weekend in York sparks Saira's active pursuit of practical habit and systems books
slices.summary: After a short York trip, Saira's interest in habit/systems books shifts from casual browsing to active seeking. She starts marking passages, keeping a note of testable ideas, and filtering for books offering immediate usability over abstract theory. She plans a one-note system with three headings (home, work, both).
open_loops: One-note system with three headings not yet set up
Ideas from books need to be date-tested for actual usefulness
decisions: After a short post-wedding weekend in York, Saira became more intentional about buying habit and systems nonfiction inst
